behaviors.description: Select app and runtime USB exports and reject installed refs of the opposite kind.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed collection app and runtime installed together.
behaviors.expected: Each kind selector rejects the opposite installed kind. App selection exports the exact app and dependency runtime; runtime selection exports only the exact runtime, preserving collection identity.

behaviors.description: Suppress the documented warning about incomplete USB source content.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed runtime installed with only the bin subpath.
behaviors.expected: Allow-partial removes the partial-content warning while preserving exit status and unrelated diagnostics. Successful exports retain selected bytes; an independent partial-export failure is recorded separately and a full-install export control must succeed.

behaviors.description: Observe USB export diagnostics around recreated quiet controls.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed app/runtime and fresh export destination for every invocation.
behaviors.expected: Both verbosity modes add diagnostics while preserving stdout and exact exported collection/ref/commit sets.

behaviors.description: Export the explicitly selected installation among default, named and user stores.
behaviors.preconditions: Disposable competing installations with independent signed A/B app commits under the same ref.
behaviors.expected: Every export has the selected installation's exact independent app/runtime commits and collection identity.

mappings.rationale: Exact public collection refs distinguish filtered app and runtime selections.

surface_assertions.rationale: App filtering selects the app and its dependency rather than a matching runtime alone.
Runtime filtering exports the matching runtime without the app.

mappings.rationale: The manual specifies warning suppression. Matching outcomes and unrelated diagnostics isolate that effect, with independent commit and payload controls.

surface_assertions.rationale: The flag suppresses the actual partial-content warning without changing unrelated diagnostics or export status.

mappings.rationale: Quiet/flagged/quiet exports retain exact independent refs while adding diagnostic output.

surface_assertions.rationale: Verbose export adds diagnostic lines without changing ordinary results.
OSTree verbosity adds diagnostic lines without changing ordinary results.

mappings.rationale: Competing installed copies and independent A/B commit oracles identify the selected source store.

surface_assertions.rationale: The user store supplies the exported refs despite competing system copies.
The default system store supplies the exported refs despite competing user/named copies.
The named store supplies its independently different B app commit.
